name: app-oviah-onboarding-first-time-users-branching-flowchart
title: OVIAH 'Onboarding — First time users' flowchart with a period-mode diamond branching to two setup paths
whatItIs: A flowchart from 'Opens App' through a welcome screen, sign-up/login, profile setup and a red 'Period Mode' diamond branching into First Period Mode and Regular Period Mode paths, each with its own app-preview and notification steps, converging on separate 'Home' end states, with 'Not clickable' labels marking read-only screens.
whatItMeans: Precise and developer-friendly; marking non-interactive screens prevents ambiguity during handoff.
techniques: Label read-only screens explicitly as 'Not clickable'.
End each onboarding branch at its own tailored home state.
Use a diamond decision node to branch by user type early.

vocabulary.definition: A label marking a screen or state with no interactive action.
Where separate flow paths lead to related but distinct end states.
